rows.model: Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN v2 (500 images)

cases.title: A tiny background car outranks the main car
cases.explanation: The detector scores small distant cars as highly as the main subject, so choosing the top score selected a background car. This hit 68 of 500 sampled test images, and the app would have identified the wrong car. Fixed: the app now crops the largest box scoring at least 0.5, chosen on validation. This image rises to IoU 0.95, and IoU failures fall to 4 of 500.

cases.title: The fix itself fails on a weak, large box
cases.predicted: Chosen box IoU 0.28, score 0.56. Top-score box IoU 0.90
cases.explanation: A large low-confidence box covering dark studio background just passes the 0.5 score limit and beats the correct box. Preferring large boxes has this cost. Possible improvement: test a higher score limit or score multiplied by area on validation. Score times area was close on validation, so it's the first candidate.

cases.title: A very close car is missed in favour of a partial one
cases.explanation: The main car fills the frame and shows its rear with a folded roof, a less common view, so no confident box covers it. The largest confident box is a sliver of another car at the edge. Possible improvement: ignore boxes cut off by the image edge when a central vehicle exists, or fall back to the full frame when the chosen box is narrow.

cases.title: Raised doors fall outside the detector's box
cases.explanation: COCO training images rarely show scissor doors, so the box covers only the body, while the annotation includes the raised doors. The Ford GT example behaves the same way. Effect on classification is unmeasured until detector-crop accuracy is run. The car's body stays in the crop, so the harm may be small. Retraining the detector on Stanford boxes could address it.

cases.title: The classical ROI locks onto the background
cases.explanation: The largest-contour method assumes the car has the strongest outline. Here the bridge does, so the ROI misses the car completely. It has no idea what a car is. This is why the app crops with the detector. The contour ROI stays as a visual explanation in the classical view, and isn't used for classification.
